_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: Coil regime with no proven library hit and no event inside 24h; statistically honest default is range-hold inside Denial until funding/F&G or ETF flows break it.
next_move.brains_agree: partial — analyst clear HOLD/Denial; narrative neutral tape, no forward phase call
next_move.confirmed_if: Fear & Greed stays ~20-38 and BTC holds recent range without funding flip or ETF-flow reversal
next_move.invalidated_if: Funding turns negative and F&G breaks under ~15 (toward Panic), or spot reclaims with positive ETF flows and F&G above 40 (toward Anxiety)
